name: Consolidated Communications (now branded Fidium) - incl. legacy FairPoint
notes: Researched from public consolidated.com support pages only (no sign-in). Consolidated Communications now markets as Fidium; bills are paid in an online customer portal reached from 'View or pay my bill' (region-specific portals), where customers can make one-time quick payments, enroll in or turn off recurring automatic payments (the confirmation email states the draft day of month, so the exact day is not published), and opt out of or back into paper bills. Accepted: checking (electronic check) and Visa, Mastercard or Discover. Phone payments at 1.844.968.7224 (automated or agent) carry a convenience fee whose amount is not published; online fees are not stated (inferred none). Payment plans are offered by phone after a disconnection for nonpayment, not online. Cancelling or changing service is by phone at 1.844.968.7224 with no penalty; equipment must be returned within 30 days. Sign-in identifier not described publicly (family default kept). Banks' bill pay lists the biller as Consolidated or Fidium; Texas customers can pay cash at Fidelity Express.

payment_arrangement.note: Payment plans are not set up online. If service was disconnected for nonpayment, call 1.844.968.7224 to work out a payment plan and reinstatement.

cancel_service.note: Call 1.844.968.7224 to cancel or change service; there is no penalty. Return equipment within 30 days.

help.title: Ways to pay your bill
paragraphs: Pay in the online customer portal from View or pay my bill: make a one-time quick payment or enroll in recurring automatic payments. Checking account transfers and Visa, Mastercard and Discover are accepted.

You can also call 1.844.968.7224 to pay through the automated system or an agent; a convenience fee applies to every phone payment. Mail a check or money order to the address on your statement with your account number on it (never cash), pay through your bank's bill pay by searching for Consolidated or Fidium, or in Texas pay at a Fidelity Express location.
A late charge may apply if a statement is not paid by its due date, and continued nonpayment can lead to disconnection.

help.title: Automatic payments
paragraphs: Log in to the online customer portal and follow the instructions to enroll in recurring automatic payments. A confirmation email tells you the day of the month the payment will be taken.
You can change the settings or turn automatic payments off at any time in the same portal.

help.title: Paperless billing
paragraphs: Opt out of paper bills, or start them again, in the online customer portal. Your account number is on the first page of your latest statement.

help.title: Payment plans after a disconnection
paragraphs: If your service was disconnected for nonpayment, call 1.844.968.7224. Consolidated will work with you on a payment plan and on getting service reinstated. Payment plans are not set up in the online portal.

help.title: Canceling service and returning equipment
paragraphs: Call 1.844.968.7224 and say what change you want; you can change your plan or cancel whenever you like with no penalty.
Consolidated tells you which equipment, such as a WiFi gateway, to send back. Return it within 30 days of cancellation, only to the address on the shipping label, to avoid unreturned equipment fees.

extra.intent: You want to pay your Fidium (Consolidated Communications) bill through your own bank's online bill pay. Using Fidium's support pages, find which biller names to search for at your bank. Do not make a payment.

solution.text: Search for Consolidated or Fidium as the biller.

extra.intent: Before cancelling Fidium (Consolidated Communications) service, find out how many days you have to return equipment after cancelling. Do not cancel anything.

solution.text: Return equipment within 30 days of cancellation.
